Want to try a few together?"* - **If you want to backtrack:** Admit the switch and ask, *"How can we handle this better as a team?"* - **If they’re resistant:** Re-evaluate—is this a dealbreaker for them? If they’re open to compromise, great; if not, it’s a sign of how they handle dietary boundaries. **Final Thought:** Love and trust are built on transparency. If you’re willing to sneakily change their food, are you also willing to have hard conversations about other things? That’s the real test. *(And yes, I’d avoid posting this on Reddit—throwaways are great for anonymity, but this is a relationship issue best handled IRL.)*
